primary_failure_policy: final provider/parse failure after the frozen retry policy is scored as downstream incorrect (score=0)
primary_denominator_policy: retain all attempted frozen condition rows in the denominator; do not drop final parse failures
paired_analysis_policy: for clean/corrupted/enforced paired effects, a final parse failure contributes score=0 for that condition rather than causing the pair to be removed
sensitivity_analysis: repeat all principal aggregates using complete-case parse-success observations only
failure_reporting: report final parse-failure rate overall and by source, analysis event, condition type, fault operator, and task subtype when available
rationale: all frozen condition rows were actually attempted
failure to produce a parseable contract-compliant response after the frozen retry policy is a downstream task failure
dropping parse failures could introduce selective complete-case bias because failures may cluster by source or task type
complete-case analysis is retained as a sensitivity analysis
timing_statement: This failure-handling policy was frozen after inference completion but before inspection of downstream task accuracy, corruption effects, recovery effects, confidence intervals, or model-comparison results.
